The Long Way Round

Notes on rebuilding the shed

3 August 2026

Posted by Rosa in Making

The old shed had been leaning for two summers, and the felt had gone at the ridge, so this year it came down.

What follows is mostly about the base, which is the part I got wrong the first time and would now do differently.

Four bearers, not three. The extra one costs nine pounds and saves a season of sagging.
